Job Summary: We are seeking an experienced Site Reliability Engineer to ensure the availability, performance, and operational excellence of large-scale distributed systems in production. As an SRE you will live at the boundary between development and operations, applying strong software engineering principles to infrastructure and operations problems, and continually pushing the platform toward higher reliability with lower operational toil. The ideal candidate will combine deep systems knowledge with strong programming skills, a measurement-driven mindset, and the discipline to design, automate, and operate complex services so that reliability becomes a first-class engineering deliverable rather than a reactive concern. Key Responsibilities - Define, instrument, and continually refine service-level objectives (SLOs), service-level indicators (SLIs), and error budgets for critical services, and use those measures to drive concrete engineering and prioritization decisions. - Lead incident response and resolution for production issues, acting as a calm and effective incident commander when needed, and ensuring high-quality post-incident reviews that drive lasting improvements. - Design and implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing strategies using Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, Datadog, or similar tooling so that operators have rich, actionable visibility into system behavior. - Build and maintain robust on-call processes, runbooks, and escalation paths that reduce mean time to detect and mean time to resolve while protecting the well-being of the engineers on rotation. - Automate operational toil aggressively by writing production-grade tooling in Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages, replacing manual workflows with reliable, auditable automation. - Architect and operate large-scale Kubernetes clusters and container-based workloads, including autoscaling, capacity planning, network policy, and integration with service meshes. - Design CI/CD pipelines that promote safe, frequent, and observable releases, supported by automated testing, canary deployments, feature flags, and progressive rollout strategies. - Lead capacity planning and performance engineering activities, building models that predict growth and stress, and validating those models through load testing and chaos experiments. - Partner closely with application development teams to embed reliability practices early in design — including failure-mode analyses, graceful degradation patterns, and dependency hardening. - Strengthen the platform’s resiliency through chaos engineering, fault injection, dependency isolation, retries, timeouts, circuit breakers, and well-tested failover paths. - Drive continuous improvement of security posture in collaboration with security teams, including patch management, vulnerability remediation, and secure-by-default platform defaults. - Contribute to the technical roadmap for reliability tooling, observability platforms, and developer-experience improvements that reduce friction and improve outcomes for engineering teams. - Mentor engineers across the organization on SRE practices and foster a strong, blameless culture of operational excellence. Required Qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. - Ten or more years of SRE, DevOps, or production engineering experience supporting large-scale distributed systems. - Strong programming skills in at least one of Python, Go, or Java, with the ability to build robust automation and tooling. - Deep, hands-on experience operating Linux at scale, including networking, performance tuning, and systems-level troubleshooting. - Production experience operating Kubernetes and container-based workloads. - Strong working knowledge of observability tooling such as Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/EFK, or commercial equivalents. - Hands-on experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for both infrastructure and applications. - Solid understanding of distributed system design, including consistency models, partitioning, and failure semantics. - Demonstrated experience leading incident response and conducting effective post-incident reviews. - Excellent communication and documentation skills. Preferred Qualifications - Experience defining and operationalizing SLOs and error budgets in real production environments. - Exposure to chaos engineering practices and tools such as Chaos Monkey, Gremlin, or Litmus. - Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP). - Background in capacity planning, performance engineering, or large-scale load testing. - Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio, Linkerd, or Consul. Our Purpose At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here. About Us SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters. Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity. What Are We Looking For? We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes. As a Director of Developer Experience, you will be tasked with leading the organization responsible for how every engineer at the company builds, tests, ships, and operates software. You will own two interconnected functions: Infrastructure Services (CI/CD orchestration, GitOps continuous delivery, artifact management, and related platforms) and Developer Tooling (the teams that design and operate our CI/CD pipelines and internal developer platform). Critically, you will also define and execute our strategy for integrating AI across the software development lifecycle, from AI-assisted code generation and review to AI-driven engineering intelligence platforms. Developer experience is one of the highest-leverage investments an engineering organization can make, and AI is the largest shift in how software is built in a generation. The Director of Developer Experience will directly shape how hundreds of engineers spend their day, how quickly we ship, how confidently we operate in production, and how effectively we harness AI across the SDLC. This is a critically important role with executive visibility and a clear mandate to deliver measurable results. What Will You Do? Primary responsibilities include: - Lead, grow, and develop a multi-team organization of managers and senior engineers spanning Infrastructure Services and Developer Tooling. - Define and execute the vision for developer experience, including build, test, deployment, artifact management, internal platform capabilities, and AI-augmented developer workflows. - Own the strategy and rollout of AI tooling across the SDLC, including AI coding assistants, AI code review and PR automation, AI-assisted test generation, and AI engineering intelligence platforms. Drive adoption, measure impact, and ensure these tools are deployed safely and effectively. - Ensure the availability, performance, and security of the systems that engineers depend on every day. - Drive the evolution of CI/CD pipelines to be faster, more reliable, more self-service, and more secure, including embedding AI capabilities such as automated triage, intelligent test selection, and AI-assisted incident response. - Establish metrics and use them to drive measurable improvement in developer productivity. - Partner with security, legal, and AI leadership to set policy for AI-generated code, IP and licensing, data handling, model selection, and acceptable-use guardrails. - Partner with security, SRE, product engineering, architecture, and AI/ML teams to align on standards, golden paths, and shared platforms. - Own the budget, tooling investments, and vendor relationships for the developer experience portfolio, including AI tooling spend. - Recruit, mentor, and retain exceptional engineering leaders and individual contributors. What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring? Ideal candidates will have: - 10+ years of progressive engineering experience, including 5+ years of engineering management and at least 2+ years leading managers (managing managers). - Demonstrated track record in building and scaling developer experience, platform engineering, or DevOps organizations in a mid-to-large engineering org. - Deep, hands-on familiarity with the modern CI/CD and developer tooling stack: Jenkins, ArgoCD, Artifactory or equivalents. - Practical experience evaluating, rolling out, and measuring the impact of AI developer tooling. - A clear point of view on how AI changes the SDLC and how to capture that value without compromising on security, code quality, or developer trust. - Strong understanding of Kubernetes, GitOps, containerization, and cloud-native deployment patterns. - Experience in defining and operating internal developer platforms and golden paths. - Excellent strategic thinking paired with a willingness to go deep on technical decisions when needed. - Strong communication and executive presence; able to influence across engineering and partner with security, compliance, legal, and product leadership. - A demonstrated bias toward developer empathy, self-service, and reducing toil. data.title: Senior System Engineer (Virtual Private Cloud Team)
data.description:
About Nebius: Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI. Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D. The role The VPC (Virtual Private Cloud) team builds and operates the core networking layer of our cloud platform. We enable virtual machines to communicate reliably by abstracting them from the underlying physical network, providing seamless IP-based connectivity even as workloads move across the datacenter. Our team designs secure, isolated private networks for customers, connects them to the public internet, and delivers essential networking services such as load balancers, firewalls, and security groups. Because nearly every cloud application depends on networking, VPC is a foundational service for the entire platform. Stability and resilience are our top priorities—we engineer systems to remain reliable and operational even when parts of the cloud experience failures. What we do: - Increase service scalability - Developing service functionality (e.g. IPv6 support, service endpoints, VPC peering, L7 load balancers and other networking services) - Improve the internal architecture, optimizing interaction with related services  In this position, your responsibility will be to: - Develop control & data plane for Nebius Cloud network services - Improve service performance and reliability - Automate complex cross-service interaction scenarios - Perform load testing for services We expect you to have: - Capable of writing reliable, high-performance code - Proficient in C/C++ or Go and ready to learn both. - Familiar with routing network traffic It would be an added bonus if you had: - Worked with VPP, DPDK, and the Linux kernel network subsystem - Well-versed in virtual networks and overlays, SDN, NFV, DPI, network protocols, routing and tunneling, BGP, and MPL We conduct coding interviews as part of the process. #LI-JS1 Benefits & Perks: - Competitive compensation - Career growth and learning opportunities - Flexibility and ownership - Collaborative and innovative culture - Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects - International environment and talented teams What's it like to work at Nebius: Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI  Equal Opportunity Statement: Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. data.description:
This is a remote position. Position Title: Principal Architect, Technology - Transport Base Salary:$155,000 to $230,000 annually DOE Bonus:Target annual bonus Benefits:Medical, dental, vision, 401k, flexible spending account, paid sick leave and paid time off, parental leave, quarterly performance bonus, training, career growth and education reimbursement programs. Ziply Fiber is a local internet service provider dedicated to elevating the connected lives of the communities we serve. We offer the fastest home internet in the nation, a refreshingly great customer experience, and affordable plans that put customers in charge. As our state-of-the-art fiber network expands, so does our need for team members who can help us grow and realize our goals. Our Company Values: - Genuinely Caring:We treat customers and colleagues like neighbors, with empathy and full attention. - Empowering You:We help customers choose what is best for them, and we support employees in implementing new ideas and solutions. - Innovation and Improvement:We constantly seek ways to improve how we serve customers and each other. - Earning Your Trust:We build trust through clear, honest, human communication. Job Summary Ziply Fiber's competitive advantage is fiber — and fiber starts with transport. The Principal Architect for Transport is the technical authority for Ziply's physical layer backbone: the dark fiber routes, long-haul rings, DWDM infrastructure, and data center interconnects that carry every bit we deliver. You will define transport topology, drive capacity planning, architect the infrastructure that enables Ziply's expansion into adjacent and edge-out markets and own the co-location strategy that positions us at the right interconnection points across the Pacific Northwest and beyond. This is a hands-on senior independent contributor role for a transport architect who thinks in fiber strands, route diversity, and wavelength economics — and who has the project management discipline to take a transport program from route survey through cutover. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: The Essential Duties and Responsibilities listed below are a range of duties performed by the employee and not intended to reflect all duties performed. Dark Fiber & Long-Haul Architecture ●Design and own Ziply's long-haul and regional dark fiber route architecture: ring topology, route diversity, redundancy standards, and failure domain analysis. ●Define fiber route acquisition strategy: IRU evaluation criteria, route survey requirements, and technical due diligence for new fiber agreements. ●Maintain authoritative transport network documentation: route inventories, fiber maps, strand assignments, splice records, and capacity databases. ●Own OTDR testing standards, fiber acceptance criteria, and ongoing plant performance monitoring. DWDM & Optical Layer ●Architect DWDM and coherent optical infrastructure: platform selection (Ciena, Infinera, Nokia, or equivalent), ROADM degree planning, and wavelength engineering for long-haul and metro rings. ●Define optical capacity planning: traffic forecasting, wavelength utilization thresholds, fiber exhaust modeling, and upgrade trigger criteria. ●Own OTN/FlexGrid transport architecture: framing standards, multiplexing hierarchy, and protection switching (OLP, OSNCP, or equivalent). ●Evaluate open line system and disaggregated optical architectures (OpenROADM, OpenConfig optical) for cost and operational fit. Data Center Interconnect & Co-location ●Architect data center interconnect (DCI) strategy: wavelength engineering, low-latency path design, and capacity scaling between Ziply facilities and third-party co-location sites. ●Define co-location strategy: meet-me room presence, cross-connect standards, and third-party peering and transit interconnect infrastructure. ●Manage relationships with co-location providers: SLA governance, capacity planning, and commercial terms aligned to Ziply's network growth roadmap. Market Expansion & Capacity Planning ●Architect transport infrastructure requirements for adjacent market expansion and edge-out programs: route planning, capacity dimensioning, and build sequencing. ●Own transport capacity planning across the network: traffic matrix modeling, link utilization monitoring, and proactive upgrade planning to stay ahead of demand. ●Partner with Network Planning on transport inputs for new market entry decisions: fiber availability, route cost, and build vs. lease analysis. ●Collaborate with IP Core & Metro architects to ensure transport and IP layer integration is optimized for performance, resilience, and cost efficiency. Other Duties ·Performs other duties as required to support the business and evolving organization. data.description:
About the team: Platform Infrastructurebuilds, operates, and continuously evolves FYUL's container platform and cloud foundation. We foster a DevOps culture through self-service tooling, enabling product engineering teams to ship reliable, secure, and cost-efficient services as the business scales. The team owns our AWS cloud accounts, Kubernetes platform, cloud networking, observability stack, core databases, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure-as-code, and acts as the go-to partner for engineering teams on cloud and DevOps topics. About the role: We're hiring a Senior SRE II to join Platform Infrastructure as one of the team's senior individual contributors. At this level, you're the go-to person for our most complex infrastructure problems: you architect and drive large-scale automation and reliability initiatives, set standards other engineers follow, and mentor Associate and mid-level SREs. You'll split your time between hands-on platform work - Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, CI/CD, observability - and technical leadership: proposing designs, reviewing others' work, and helping the team make good build-vs-buy and cost/reliability trade-offs. Your daily tasks will include: - Infrastructure & reliability: Architect and manage highly available, secure, and scalable infrastructure across multiple AWS accounts and environments using infrastructure as code. - Design and operate our Amazon EKS clusters, including networking policies, persistent storage, and scaling strategies for containerized workloads. - Own and evolve core platform services:cloud networking, Kubernetes, and the databases and messaging systems engineering teams depend on. - Automation & infrastructure as code: Drive large-scale automation projects and set standards for using Terraform / Terragrunt and GitOps (ArgoCD) across teams. - Lead adoption of automation to reduce manual operational work and keep environments consistent and repeatable. - Observability & incident response: Be the go-to person for solving complex, cross-service infrastructure problems. - Drive initiatives that improve reliability and observability (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Mimir) so systems scale with minimal manual intervention. - Participate in on-call rotation, lead incident response for production issues, and write clear runbooks, ADRs, and postmortems. - Security & cost efficiency: Lead security efforts within the team - IAM, encryption, secure logging - and mentor others on secure infrastructure practices. - Audit infrastructure spend regularly and drive cost optimization across the platform (rightsizing, autoscaling, FinOps practices). - Collaboration & mentorship: Mentor mid-level SREs, provide detailed feedback, and support onboarding of new team members. - Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. - Partner with product engineering squads to understand their needs and represent Platform Infrastructure in cross-team initiatives. Your qualifications: These reflect the technical bar we hold Senior SRE II's to internally, based on our SRE competency framework and current stack. - Core technical experience: - Solid Linux systems administration background and comfort scripting in Python. - Strong AWS knowledge: EKS, IAM (roles, policies, IRSA), VPC networking, RDS, S3, SQS, and familiarity with the Well-Architected Framework; experience in multi-account AWS environments is a strong plus. - Hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting Kubernetes (EKS) at production scale, including Helm chart development, CNI networking (we run Cilium), pod networking/IPAM concepts, and container security (ECR, image scanning). - Proficiency with Terraform (modules, state management) and ideally Terragrunt for multi-environment management; GitOps experience with ArgoCD. - Experience with Postgres, MySQL and/or MongoDB in production scale, including Aurora. - CI/CD experience with Jenkins (Jenkinsfile, shared libraries) and/or GitHub Actions, and familiarity with deployment strategies such as blue-green and canary. - Experience with the Grafana observability stack (Grafana, Prometheus, Loki, Tempo, Mimir) - metrics design, dashboarding, alerting, log aggregation, and distributed tracing. Not only using but also maintaining it. - Practical incident management experience: on-call rotations, structured incident response, and writing runbooks/postmortems. - Working knowledge of 12-Factor App principles and cost optimization / FinOps awareness. 2.How you work: - A methodical, data-driven approach to troubleshooting rather than guessing. - Strong written communication - you write runbooks, ADRs, and postmortems that others can actually follow. - Comfortable driving initiatives with ambiguous ownership, and taking accountability for outcomes rather than waiting to be asked. - Track record of mentoring less senior engineers and giving direct, constructive feedback. - Several years of hands-on production infrastructure/SRE experience, with demonstrated ownership of initiatives at a senior individual-contributor level (leading design work, setting standards, being the escalation point for hard problems). 3. Nice to have: - GCP Experience. - Experience with Kafka / AWS MSK. - Prior experience in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments (security best practices, access reviews). - Experience contributing to a platform/DevEx roadmap that other engineering teams consume as a self-service product. Our tech stack: - Languages:PHP (Symfony), Node.js (TypeScript), Angular (TypeScript). - Data:PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB. - Infra: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Atlantis - Engineering Tools:Postman, Git, GitHub Copilot, PhpStorm, Grafana, Kibana, Prometheus. - Remote work Tools:Jira, Miro, Google Workspace, Slack. - Development Practices:Pair Programming, Code Reviews, Continuous Integration/Deployment. What we offer: - A global, inclusive team that’s as supportive as it is ambitious and serious about getting things done - An opportunity to work remotely or in a modern and welcoming office in Riga - Flexible working hours (start your day as late as 11 AM) - Private health insurance - 2 extra paid days off to focus on your mental or physical well-being - 1 extra paid day off to celebrate a Birthday or any other celebration of your choice - Internal and external learning opportunities - Access to mentorship, internal meetups, and hackathons, both on-site and online - Free and healthy lunch if you work from the Rīga office - Design and order your own merch using our platforms with an employee discount - Exciting team-building events and parties you’ll never forget! FYUL is the engine that powers on-demand commerce at global scale. Formed in 2024 through the merger of Printful, Printify, and Snow Commerce, we bring together tech, talent, and infrastructure to help people turn ideas into beautiful products. From solo creators to entertainment giants, FYUL powers merch that connects with millions, backed by advanced tech, premium production, and global reach. We're a fast-growing global company working toward powering great brands, great experiences, and great people. We are an equal-opportunity workplace. We’re committed to diversity and inclusion and make hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and work experience. If you think you’d excel in this role, send us your resume in English, showing us why you are the right person for the job. Interested, but don’t think this is the right fit for you? Feel free to share it with friends and check out other open positions at our career site. We’re always looking for creative and driven minds to join our ever-growing team! AS Printful Latvia (Reģ. You will work on meaningful projects that accelerate the adoption of advanced technologies, from strategy and discovery through to full product delivery, helping turn complex challenges into measurable outcomes. We are looking for someone with good communication skills, ideally with experience making decisions, being proactive, used to working autonomously, and with good attention to detail. This role requires a senior profile who can add value quickly with minimal ramp-up or supervision — it is not suitable for a junior candidate. What you will do: - Take ownership of AWS infrastructure work for the product engineering team - Act as a bridge between the engineering team and CloudOps, ensuring smooth collaboration and alignment - Support infrastructure improvements, refactoring, and performance-tuning initiatives - Offload infrastructure/DevOps tasks from the engineering team, enabling them to focus on business logic and product development - Work autonomously to identify and resolve infrastructure challenges with minimal supervision - Contribute to the reliability, scalability, and performance of cloud infrastructure What you will bring: - 7+ years of hands-on experience as a DevOps Engineer, with a strong track record in senior-level roles - Strong AWS expertise, with proven ability to take ownership of cloud infrastructure work - Experience acting as a liaison between engineering and CloudOps/infrastructure teams - A high level of autonomy — able to add value quickly with minimal onboarding or supervision - Solid experience with infrastructure refactoring and performance tuning - Strong communication skills and a proactive mindset Nice to have: - Experience working within embedded or cross-functional product teams - Familiarity with AI-driven platforms or SaaS environments - Experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation tooling What we offer: - 100% Remote Work - WFH allowance: Monthly payment as financial support for remote working. - Career Growth: We have established a career development program accessible for all employees with 360º feedback that will help us to guide you in your career progression. - Training: For Tech training at Zartis, you have time allocated during the week at your disposal. You can request from a variety of options, such as online courses (from Pluralsight and Educative.io, for example), English classes, books, conferences, and events. - Mentoring Program: You can become a mentor in Zartis or you can receive mentorship, or both. - Zartis Wellbeing Hub (Kara Connect): A platform that provides sessions with a range of specialists, including mental health professionals, nutritionists, physiotherapists, fitness coaches, and webinars with such professionals as well. - Multicultural working environment: We organize tech events, webinars, parties, and activities to do online team-building games and contests.

data.title: Senior Technical Consultant - Storage
data.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD. We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived. We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD. AHEAD is seeking a Senior Technical Consultant to join the Storage Delivery team. This is a customer-facing, delivery-focused role responsible for leading the design, implementation, migration, and optimization of enterprise storage solutions across data center and cloud environments. The candidate for this role must have extensive experience leading, designing, deploying, and testing modern data center, Cloud, and hybrid storage infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings deep hands-on experience across block, file, object, and unstructured data storage; strong SAN and data mobility skills; and the ability to lead complex delivery workstreams from discovery through execution. This role is well suited for a senior consultant who can translate business and technical requirements into practical solutions, execute with quality, and serve as a trusted advisor to both customers and internal teams. This position is remote and expected to support project-based delivery, maintenance windows, and occasional after-hours work tied to migrations, cutovers, and escalations. Key Responsibilities: - Lead the design and implementation of enterprise storage solutions for performance, scalability, recoverability, and operational simplicity across on-premises and cloud environments. - Plan and execute file, object, and unstructured data migrations, technology refreshes, and data mobility initiatives with minimal business disruption. - Lead block storage migrations including interoperability analysis, LUN mapping, zoning, masking, multipathing validation, replication planning, cutover execution, rollback preparation, and post-migration validation. - Design and deploy data center and cloud storage platforms including Dell PowerMax/VMAX, PowerScale/Isilon, PowerStore, NetApp ONTAP and StorageGRID, Pure FlashArray and FlashBlade, Nasuni, Cloudian, and related technologies. - Design, configure, and deploy SAN infrastructure including Cisco and Brocade Fibre Channel switching. - Support and troubleshoot replication and business continuity technologies such as SRDF, SyncIQ, Pure replication, SnapMirror, and other array-based data protection tools. - Serve as the primary technical lead during delivery engagements, customer meetings, cutovers, and escalation events. - Collaborate with project managers, architects, sales teams, and customer stakeholders to align scope, timelines, risks, and technical outcomes. - Develop high-quality technical documentation including solution designs, implementation plans, migration runbooks, as-built documentation, and knowledge transfer materials. - Mentor junior consultants and promote delivery consistency, technical quality, and customer satisfaction across the team. - Contribute to continuous improvement of delivery methods through automation, reusable tooling, documentation standards, and practical use of AI-enabled productivity tools. Skills Required - 10+ years of hands-on experience in enterprise storage infrastructure delivery, professional services, or complex customer-facing consulting environments. - Strong experience with enterprise storage platforms such as Dell EMC PowerMax/VMAX, PowerScale/Isilon, Unity, PowerStore, Pure Storage, NetApp, Nasuni, Cloudian, and similar technologies. - Proven experience with SAN design, deployment, migration, and interoperability analysis. - Strong hands-on experience with unstructured data migration tools and methods, including platforms such as Komprise, DataDobi, and native migration tooling. - Experience migrating SMB and NFS workloads, including multiprotocol environments and associated dependencies. - Deep understanding of file, object, block, and cloud storage environments, including lifecycle assessment, planning, and migration. - Experience designing and supporting storage solutions across major hyperscale cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud. - Strong Automation and scripting skills for automating infrastructure and operational workflows using tools such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, JavaScript, Ansible, Terraform, or Jenkins. - Strong troubleshooting skills across storage arrays, hosts, switches, connectivity layers, and backup ecosystems. - Experience supporting Windows, Linux, and virtualized infrastructure environments. - Working knowledge of Active Directory and DNS as they relate to storage and file services delivery. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain risks, decisions, and recommendations to both technical and business stakeholders. - Strong documentation skills, including solution documentation, diagrams, implementation plans, and as-built deliverables. - Experience leading technical workstreams independently on multi-phase or high-complexity customer engagements. - Experienced with AI productivity tools such as Copilot and practical uses of AI to improve delivery quality, speed, and consistency. - Holds relevant partner or vendor certifications across storage, SAN, cloud, or data mobility technologies. - Experience mentoring consultants and helping raise delivery standards across a broader team. Success Profile - Takes technical ownership of delivery engagements and leads as a subject matter expert. - Delivers projects with strong quality, clear communication, and minimal unplanned disruption. - Builds credibility quickly with customer engineering teams and internal AHEAD stakeholders. - Identifies risks early, communicates clearly, and drives issues through resolution. - Balances deep technical execution with customer service, business awareness, and team collaboration. - Strong Mentoring capabilities to teach and mentor less qualified individuals. Why AHEAD: Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.India Employment Benefits include: Comprehensive health insurance coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents Paid time off and company holidays, along with additional leave benefits as per policy Flexible work arrangements, supporting work-life balance Learning and development opportunities to support continuous growth and upskilling Employee wellness initiatives and programs focused on physical and mental well-being Retirement and statutory benefits in line with India regulations Inclusive and people-first culture, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

data.title: DevOps Manager, Infrastructure
data.description:
Overview The DevOps Manager, Infrastructure is a people leader and technical operator responsible for leading the team that builds, runs, and continuously improves the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and operational systems that Engineering teams and clients depend on every day. This manager sets a high bar for infrastructure reliability, deployment velocity, and operational discipline — building a team culture where automation is the default, manual work is treated as a problem to be solved, and every Engineer on the team is actively leveraging AI to work faster, diagnose issues more accurately, and build infrastructure that operates intelligently at scale. This is a hands-on technical leader who coaches Engineers on infrastructure engineering craft, drives AI adoption into daily DevOps workflows, holds the team accountable for the reliability and performance of the systems they own, and partners with Engineering, Security, and Product teams to ensure cloud operations are a source of competitive advantage — not a constraint on what engineering can deliver. Starting base pay for this role is between $145,000 and $185,000. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, training, location, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role will be eligible for a bonus as well as competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness reimbursement, life insurance, and a 401(k) with company match. We offer vacation and sick leave benefits (under a flexible time off policy in most states). Responsibilities - People Leadership & Team Development - Leads, develops, and retains a team of DevOps Engineers — building a high-performance team culture defined by technical excellence, automation mindset, operational ownership, and a continuous improvement orientation that makes the team better every sprint.  - Sets clear goals, role expectations, and success criteria for each team member — conducting regular 1:1s, providing direct and constructive feedback, and ensuring every engineer on the team has a visible path for technical growth and career progression.  - Conducts structured performance reviews that recognize strong operational contributions, address delivery or quality gaps with support and specificity, and develop team members who are growing in both AI tooling fluency and foundational infrastructure engineering depth.  - Identifies capability gaps across the team — including in areas such as infrastructure-as-code, AI-assisted operations, container orchestration, security controls, and observability engineering — and develop targeted hiring, upskilling, and cross-training plans that keep the team ahead of organizational demand.  - Fosters a team culture where every manual process is treated as a temporary state, automation is the permanent solution, and AI tooling is an expected part of how every engineer approaches their work — not an optional enhancement.  - Supports Engineering hiring across the broader organization by participating in technical interviews, contributing to DevOps role design, and helping calibrate the infrastructure engineering bar for the engineering organization.  Cloud Infrastructure Operations & Strategy  - Owns the operational health of the organization's AWS cloud infrastructure — setting the team's standards for provisioning, configuration management, environment consistency, patching cadences, capacity planning, and cost optimization across all environments.  - Leads the team's infrastructure-as-code practice — ensuring all AWS resources are defined, versioned, peer-reviewed, and deployed through Terraform or AWS CDK, and that manual infrastructure changes are treated as exceptions that are immediately codified rather than accepted as standard practice.  - Drives cloud cost efficiency as a continuous management discipline — working with the team to implement right-sizing, reserved capacity strategies, auto-scaling policies, and resource cleanup automation that maintain performance while controlling cloud spend as the platform scales.  - Oversees the team's management of core AWS services — including EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, VPC, Route 53, IAM, CloudFront, and Auto Scaling Groups — ensuring configurations are standardized, documented, and aligned with the organization's architectural and security standards.  - Partners with the Director of DevOps and Network Engineer to ensure infrastructure architecture reflects network security controls, traffic routing policies, and connectivity requirements — operating infrastructure that is reliable and secure at every layer.  CI/CD Pipeline Delivery & Release Operations  - Leads the team's delivery of CI/CD pipeline infrastructure — ensuring Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions pipelines are reliable, fast, and maintained to a high standard, and that Engineering teams have the pipeline support they need to ship code confidently and frequently.  - Partners with the Release Automation Engineer to ensure infrastructure provisioning, environment configuration, and deployment automation are tightly integrated with the release pipeline — enabling fully automated promotion workflows and holding the team accountable for the infrastructure reliability that automated releases depend on.  - Oversees the team's management of artifact repositories, container registries, and deployment automation for containerized services, Lambda functions, ECS tasks, and EKS workloads — ensuring deployment patterns are consistent, traceable, and recoverable across all environments.  - Holds the team accountable for pipeline reliability — coaching Engineers to diagnose and eliminate the root causes of flaky pipelines and intermittent infrastructure failures rather than treating them as acceptable operational noise.  - Tracks and reports CI/CD performance metrics — including build cycle times, deployment success rates, pipeline failure rates, and deployment frequency — using data to drive continuous improvement in the team's pipeline delivery quality and engineering velocity impact.  AI-Augmented DevOps Operations  - Drives the adoption of AI development tools — including Claude Code and Cursor — across the DevOps team's daily workflow, establishing clear norms for AI-assisted infrastructure-as-code authoring, automation script generation, pipeline configuration, and operational documentation that maximize the team's engineering output.  - Champions AI-assisted operations as a management discipline — directing the team to integrate AI-powered log analysis, intelligent anomaly detection, automated runbook generation, and LLM-augmented incident analysis into operational workflows that reduce mean time to diagnosis and improve resolution quality.  - Uses AI to accelerate the team's most demanding infrastructure work — including large-scale infrastructure audit and compliance analysis, automated drift detection, AI-generated capacity planning recommendations, and intelligent alerting configuration — and share effective patterns with engineering leadership.  - Evaluates AI-native infrastructure intelligence tools — including AI-assisted deployment risk scoring, predictive scaling, and LLM-powered operational documentation — and make evidence-based recommendations to the Director of DevOps on where AI tooling investments will deliver the highest operational return.  - Holds team members accountable for AI tool adoption and proficiency — incorporating AI fluency into performance conversations, development plans, and hiring criteria to ensure the team's capability in AI-augmented DevOps keeps pace with the organization's AI-first engineering direction.  Observability, Monitoring & Incident Response  - Leads the team's ownership of infrastructure and application observability — ensuring comprehensive monitoring dashboards, alerting policies, log aggregation, and anomaly detection are in place across the infrastructure stack using Datadog, CloudWatch, SumoLogic, and related tooling.  - Holds the team accountable for alert quality — coaching Engineers to build monitoring that surfaces actionable signals with appropriate urgency rather than generating noise that erodes on-call confidence and response effectiveness.  - Owns the team's on-call model — managing rotation schedules, escalation paths, and on-call readiness standards, and ensuring every engineer on the team is equipped with the runbooks, tooling access, and AI-assisted investigation capabilities needed to resolve incidents effectively.  - Leads post-incident reviews for infrastructure-related failures — facilitating blameless retrospectives, producing structured root cause analyses, and owning follow-through on corrective actions that improve system resilience and prevent recurrence.  - Tracks infrastructure reliability metrics — including availability, MTTR, change failure rate, and deployment frequency — reporting trends and improvement actions to the Director of DevOps with the regularity and specificity that operational management requires.  Security, Compliance & Access Management  - Holds the team accountable for infrastructure security controls across all AWS environments — including IAM policy governance, security group management, secrets management, encryption standards, vulnerability patching cadences, and compliance with security baselines aligned to NIST 800-53, ISO/IEC 27001, and SOC 2.  - Ensures the team conducts regular infrastructure security assessments — reviewing IAM permissions, security group configurations, exposed endpoints, and compliance configurations — and drives timely remediation of identified gaps without exception.  - Owns the team's infrastructure access governance — ensuring provisioning and de-provisioning processes are timely, least-privilege based, regularly reviewed, and audit-ready at all times.  - Supports audit readiness and evidence collection for infrastructure-related SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, and NIST 800-53 controls — maintaining accurate records of infrastructure configurations, access grants, and change history as a non-negotiable operational standard.  - Partners with Application Security Engineers to integrate infrastructure-level security controls — including container scanning, secrets management, and network policy enforcement — into the CI/CD pipeline and deployment automation workflows managed by the team.  Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management  - Serves as the primary operational partner to Engineering delivery teams — providing infrastructure consultation during system design, advising on cloud service selection, and ensuring Engineering teams can build services that are operationally sound and reliably deployable.  - Collaborates with the Engineering Systems Manager to ensure CI/CD pipeline configurations and DevOps tooling are governed within Azure DevOps and GitHub with appropriate access controls, standards alignment, and change tracking.  - Partners with the Release Workflow Manager on release planning and deployment coordination — ensuring the infrastructure and pipeline capacity required for each release cycle is available, validated, and ready before promotion proceeds.  - Represents the DevOps team in Engineering leadership forums — communicating infrastructure health, operational risk, team capacity, and improvement roadmap with the clarity and data-backed specificity that engineering and operations leadership needs.  - Manages vendor and tooling relationships relevant to the DevOps infrastructure domain — including monitoring platforms, cloud provider support, and CI/CD tooling — ensuring SLAs are met and escalations are handled with urgency.  Qualifications - Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field - 6+ years of DevOps or cloud infrastructure engineering experience, including 2+ years in a management role with direct people leadership accountability for a DevOps or Infrastructure Engineering team.  - Demonstrated track record of leading and developing technical teams — hiring, coaching, performance management, and building high-performance DevOps team culture.  - Deep hands-on proficiency with AWS cloud services — including EC2, ECS, EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudFront, and Auto Scaling — with demonstrated experience designing and operating production AWS environments at scale.  - Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tooling — Terraform and/or AWS CDK required — including the ability to review, guide, and hold the team accountable for IaC quality and consistency.  - Proficiency in scripting and automation languages including Python, PowerShell, and Bash — with the technical depth to coach Engineers on automation quality and review automation code produced by the team.  - Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipeline platforms — Azure DevOps Pipelines and/or GitHub Actions required — including pipeline design, optimization, and troubleshooting at a depth sufficient to lead a team doing this work.  - Experience with container technologies including Docker, ECS, and EKS — including image build pipelines, container registry management, and containerized service deployment automation.  - Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, CloudWatch, SumoLogic, or equivalent — at a depth sufficient to set team standards and review team-produced monitoring configurations.  - Demonstrated experience driving AI tool adoption within a DevOps or infrastructure engineering team — including AI-assisted IaC authoring, AI-augmented log analysis, or intelligent alerting and automation workflows.  - Strong troubleshooting, incident management, and on-call leadership skills — able to lead the team through high-pressure production incidents with structure, calm, and effective coordination.  Preferred Qualifications - AWS certification at the associate or professional level (e.g., AWS Solutions Architect, AWS DevOps Engineer — Professional).  - Experience with configuration management tooling such as Ansible, Chef, Puppet, or SaltStack in a production infrastructure environment.  - Experience implementing SRE practices including SLOs, error budgets, and chaos engineering within a managed infrastructure team.  - Familiarity with Temporal or AWS Step Functions for workflow orchestration in the context of infrastructure automation or deployment pipelines.  - Experience with logging and observability tooling including Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana (ELK), Graylog, Fluent, or equivalent log aggregation platforms.  - Experience supporting compliance frameworks including SOC 2, NIST 800-53, or ISO/IEC 27001 — including managing team accountability for control evidence and audit readiness.  - Experience evaluating and adopting AI-native infrastructure intelligence tools — including AI-assisted deployment risk scoring, predictive scaling, or LLM-powered operational runbook generation.  - A leadership philosophy grounded in the conviction that a great DevOps team is defined not by how fast it responds to incidents, but by how rarely incidents occur — because the team built systems, automation, and AI-augmented operations that prevent them.  Benefits - Medical and Dental coverage available for employees, dependents, domestic partners, and spouses - Paid Time Off – Flexible options plus 10 paid company holidays where available** - All full-time positions are hybrid, with many eligible to be completely remote - Fully Paid by Origami Risk – Vision insurance, Short & Long-Term Disability Insurance, and Basic Life Insurance - Generous family leave options—including adoption and foster care placements - Pre-Tax Savings Accounts – Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Commuter Benefits, Dependent Care Savings Account - Retirement Savings – 401(k) with company match up to 4% - Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential & Free support offered to colleagues facing personal or work-related complications - Education Assistance Program – to help colleagues pursue industry/role-specific certifications - Wellness Benefits – reimbursement program to invest in healthy habits as well as support better colleague productivity and stress management - Additional coverages available – Pet Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Voluntary Life & AD&D coverage **Flexible PTO not available in California or the UKWho We Are Origami Risk delivers single-platform SaaS solutions that help organizations best navigate the complexities of risk, insurance, compliance, and safety management. Founded by industry veterans who recognized the need for risk management technology that was more configurable, intuitive, and scalable, Origami continues to add to its innovative product offerings for managing both insurable and uninsurable risk; facilitating compliance; improving safety; and helping insurers, MGAs, TPAs, and brokers provide enhanced services that drive results. A singular focus on client success underlies Origami’s approach to developing, implementing, and supporting our award-winning software solutions. Origami Risk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We thrive and benefit from diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. About the role Concept Plus is seeking a highly experienced Technical Lead / OCI Architect to serve as the senior technical authority for providing common services for Oracle eBusiness applications hosted on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) platforms. You will lead a team of cloud and Oracle engineers, drive critical product trade studies across the Oracle technology stack, and serve as the primary technical interface with Government System Engineers, Product Owners, Oracle OEM representatives, DISA, and Cloud One stakeholders. This is a key leadership position requiring deep hands-on expertise across OCI core services, Oracle eBusiness Suite (eBS), Oracle Fusion Middleware, Oracle databases, and the full range of Oracle integration and identity management products. What you'll do - Serve as senior technical architect and authority for all common services on Cloud One OCI, governing solutions across Compute, Networking, VCN, Storage, IAM, and Compartments - Architect and oversee environment migrations to OCI, including Oracle eBS, Oracle Fusion Middleware, and WebLogic infrastructure, ensuring continuity of operations throughout the migration lifecycle - Direct DevSecOps pipeline implementation, Infrastructure as Code (IaC/Terraform on OCI), and automated test framework design across the service lifecycle - Design and maintain near real-time Production-to-DR/COOP data replication architecture, including GoldenGate topology, RPO/RTO design, and failover validation - Conduct early OCI fit/gap analyses, pilot critical services, and maintain Oracle OEM escalation paths to mitigate service-version mismatch risk during migration - Own Architecture and Design Documentation, integration control documents (ICDs), and interface mapping with DISA, Cloud One, and mission partner systems - Provide technical leadership and hands-on guidance to engineers across OCI, database, integration, IAM, analytics, and GRC disciplines within Integrated Team Structures - Author and maintain recurring technical deliverables including DevSecOps artifacts, data migration plans, security/RMF documentation, and DR/COOP design products - Collaborate with the Cybersecurity Lead and ISSO to embed RMF controls, support ATO maintenance, and sustain DoD 8570/8140 and SOC 1 Type 2 compliance - Advise on AI/ML integration into the environment, scoping use cases to authorized data and OCI-native services within the established authorization boundary Required Qualifications - US Citizen - Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Systems Engineering, or related technical field - 8+ years of progressive Oracle and cloud architecture experience - 5+ years of direct, hands-on experience with major OCI components (Compute, Networking, VCN, Storage, IAM, Compartments) in a Federal, DoD, or large enterprise environment - Deep expertise across the Oracle ERP/middleware stack: Oracle eBS, Oracle Fusion Middleware, Oracle WebLogic Server, Oracle Database (RAC, Data Guard, RMAN), and Oracle GoldenGate - Demonstrated experience conducting formal Oracle technology trade studies and producing architecture decision records for Government or enterprise stakeholders - Active DoD Secret clearance required to start - Active DoD 8140/8570 IAT-II or higher certification required at time of hire (qualifying certifications include CompTIA Security+ CE, CompTIA CySA+, GSEC, SSCP, GICSP, CND, or any IAT-III equivalent such as CASP+ CE, CISSP, CISA, CCNP Security, GCED, or GCIH) Preferred Qualifications - Active Top Secret (TS) security clearance - Master's degree in a relevant technical field - Experience supporting DoD programs on Cloud One or DISA-managed cloud (IL4/IL5 authorization, tenancy governance, DISA approval processes) - Hands-on experience with OCI GoldenGate Microservice, OCI IAM SSO Asserter, Oracle Unified Directory (OUD), Oracle Analytics Cloud (OAC), and Oracle Risk Management Cloud - Experience implementing IaC using Terraform on OCI and deploying DevSecOps CI/CD pipelines in a DoD environment - Prior experience supporting AFLCMC, BES Directorate, or a DoD ERP program of record - Familiarity with DESMF, DoD RMF/ATO processes, and SOC 1 Type 2 compliance in a Federal financial management context - Additional certifications in ITIL, DevSecOps, Agile/SAFe, or DoD 8570/8140 (IAT/IAM Level II or higher) Concept Plus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. data.title: AI Platform Engineering Manager
data.description:
Job Summary: This is a greenfield platform function for Creative Chaos and its subsidiaries. You will build and run the internal platform (infrastructure, internal tools, IT operations, and the people who maintain them) that runs AI agents alongside human engineers as a deliberate operating model. You are also the architect and manager of every AI workflow, tool, and agent the ventures inside the group rely on day to day. Not a company that’s planning to “explore AI next year.” A group where AI tooling is already in the workflow, and you will shape how it evolves. Responsibilities: What you’ll own - Infrastructure. Proxmox clusters, AWS workloads, self-hosted services (SSO, wikis, observability, internal apps). You decide the architecture, you ship the IaC, you own the runbooks. - Internal apps and agents. When a venture needs an internal tool, dashboard, ai agent, or workflow automation, your team scopes it, builds it, and ships it. You write code on this team, not just review it. - AI workflows across the group. Every venture has its own AI needs. You partner with the lead of each, scope what they need, design the workflow, and ship it. You are the person every department head comes to when they want AI in their work. - IT operations. Identity, endpoint management, access reviews, the unglamorous reliability work that keeps 150 people productive. - The translation layer. Stakeholders bring you problems in plain English. You turn them into technical specs your team can ship. You’ll lead three direct reports today: one each for IT, infrastructure, and tools/apps. The team grows from there based on what the ventures need. How you’ll work The operating model is AI-native. You will work alongside an AI DevOps agent that maintains runbooks, proposes architecture, and reviews infrastructure changes. Claude or Cursor are daily tools for you and your team, the same way an IDE is. Infrastructure is code by default. Documentation is written as work happens, not after. If the idea of pairing with an AI agent on architecture review is interesting rather than uncomfortable, you’ll fit the room. Requirements - 5-10 years of experience. Where you started as a developer, moved into DevOps or platform engineering, and never stopped writing code. You’ve been doing this long enough to have opinions about what works. - You’ve managed small teams (2-5 people) and were good at it, but the management didn’t pull you out of the work. - You have excellent organizational discipline. Drift is your enemy. SOPs, runbooks, and documentation stay current because you keep them current, not because someone reminds you. - You communicate clearly across functions. You can sit with the head of sales, the head of finance, or the head of operations, listen past the stated problem to the real one, and walk out with a working spec. - You already use AI coding tools in your daily work, not because someone told you to, but because you tried them and they made you better. - You’re comfortable owning ambiguity. Nobody hands you a roadmap. You build it. You’re not a fit if - You haven’t shipped code in years and prefer it that way. - You’re a deep specialist (pure SRE, pure observability, pure security) who wants to go deeper into one layer. - You need a fully scoped backlog before you can start. - You let documentation rot. You think SOPs are someone else’s job. - AI in your daily workflow feels like noise rather than amplification.

data.title: Vice President, Engineering - Studio, Gym & Enterprise
data.description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together! Our Values Best Life We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact. Growth Mindset We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally. One Team From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive. What You Will Own Gym, Studio, and Enterprise product engineering You will lead engineering for the products and platforms that support the operational needs of gyms, studios, and enterprise fitness operators. You will ensure teams have clear ownership, sound technical direction, and strong execution across staff-facing workflows, platform capabilities, integrations, and enterprise account needs. You will be accountable for ensuring these platforms are reliable, scalable, secure, and positioned to support the evolving needs of ABC Fitness customers. AI-enabled SDLC transformation You will lead the AI-enabled transformation of software development lifecycle practices within the Gym, Studio, and Enterprise engineering organization. In partnership with the VP focused on engineering enablement, peer VPs, and senior technical leaders, you will help your teams adopt shared tools, practices, and operating models that improve productivity, quality, delivery predictability, documentation, testing, release management, and production support. This role is not limited to tool rollout. It requires helping teams evolve how they plan, build, test, release, measure, and continuously improve software using AI responsibly and effectively. Global engineering leadership You will lead a globally distributed engineering organization with team members across North America, Brazil, Europe, and India. You will establish leadership systems, communication practices, planning rhythms, and operating models that keep teams aligned across time zones, cultures, and product areas. You will be responsible for building clarity, trust, accountability, and shared context across distributed teams while ensuring leaders and engineers remain connected to ABC Fitness priorities and customer outcomes. You will also work closely with the CTO and other leaders across ABC Fitness to strengthen collaboration, align engineering practices, and build a successful team within your portfolio and across the broader ABC Fitness organization. Operational excellence, reliability, and quality You will be accountable for improving the operational health of the systems in your portfolio. This includes reliability, observability, incident response, release quality, regression discipline, service ownership, and production support practices. You will create mechanisms to identify recurring customer and operational pain, prioritize systemic fixes, and reduce the need for repeated escalations. You will help teams build a culture of ownership where quality, reliability, and maintainability are treated as core product outcomes. Platform modernization and technical health You will lead modernization efforts across current and legacy platforms, balancing customer commitments with long-term architectural improvement. You will help teams make pragmatic technical decisions, reduce technical debt, simplify integrations, and improve the scalability and maintainability of ABC Fitness platforms. You will work with architecture, security, infrastructure, and product leaders to ensure the portfolio has the technical foundations needed to support growth, enterprise needs, and future product innovation. Talent, culture, and leadership development You will lead, coach, and develop engineering directors, managers, architects, and senior technical leaders. You will create clarity around roles, responsibilities, decision-making, and accountability across the organization. You will be responsible for organizational design, talent planning, hiring, succession planning, performance management, and leadership development. You will build a culture that values ownership, collaboration, technical excellence, customer focus, inclusion, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities - Lead engineering across the Gym, Studio, and Enterprise product areas, including Ignite, Glofox, API platforms, and staff-facing operational experiences for clubs and studios. - Own technical strategy, delivery execution, operational excellence, and engineering culture for the portfolio. - Partner with Product and business leadership to define measurable customer, business, and operational outcomes. - Translate company priorities into clear engineering plans, investment choices, sequencing decisions, and execution rhythms. - Drive AI-enabled SDLC adoption across the Gym, Studio, and Enterprise engineering organization, partnering with the engineering enablement VP and peer leaders to roll out shared practices, support team transition, and improve productivity, quality, and operating discipline. - Lead and develop a globally distributed engineering organization across North America, Brazil, Europe, and India. - Improve delivery predictability, product quality, platform reliability, security posture, and operational efficiency. - Drive modernization of legacy and current platforms, APIs, integrations, and staff-facing operational systems. - Strengthen engineering operating rhythms, including planning, execution, dependency management, incident response, release readiness, and portfolio-level reporting. - Partner with Customer Success, Support, and enterprise stakeholders to understand customer pain, resolve escalations, and prioritize systemic improvements. - Build, coach, and develop engineering leaders, creating strong succession plans and clear accountability across the organization. - Promote scalable communication practices, strong cross-functional alignment, and consistent execution across distributed teams. - Represent engineering in executive discussions, product planning, customer conversations, and strategic transformation initiatives. Experience Must Have - Engineering Leadership: 10+ years of software engineering leadership experience, including experience leading multiple teams, multiple product areas, or a large engineering portfolio. - Executive Experience: Experience as a VP, Senior Director, or equivalent engineering leader in a SaaS, enterprise software, platform, commerce, payments, fitness technology, or complex multi-product environment. - Organizational Transformation: Proven ability to lead engineering organizations through scale, modernization, operational improvement, and organizational transformation. - Global Team Leadership: Experience leading globally distributed engineering teams across multiple regions and time zones. - Technical Judgment: Strong technical judgment across architecture, APIs, cloud platforms, integrations, reliability, security, quality, and engineering productivity. - Outcome Orientation: Experience partnering with Product and business leaders to translate strategy into measurable outcomes and executable engineering plans. - Operational Excellence: Demonstrated ability to improve delivery predictability, operational discipline, platform reliability, and product quality. - Talent Development: Experience leading leaders, developing senior technical and management talent, and building high-performing engineering cultures. - Change Leadership: Ability to drive change across teams and influence peers without relying solely on direct reporting authority. - Executive Communication: Strong executive communication skills with the ability to communicate portfolio health, risks, trade-offs, and technical strategy clearly. - Strategic Execution: Ability to balance strategic leadership with operational accountability and hands-on problem solving when needed. Nice to Have - Fitness Technology: Experience with fitness, wellness, membership management, billing, payments, commerce, CRM, or club / studio management platforms. - Staff-Facing Systems: Experience supporting operational systems used by business staff to manage day-to-day workflows. - Enterprise Customer Needs: Experience supporting enterprise customers with complex integration needs, account-specific requirements, SLAs, escalations, and platform dependencies. - API Platforms: Experience with API platform strategy, integration ecosystems, or enterprise platform capabilities. - Platform Modernization: Experience modernizing legacy platforms while continuing to deliver customer-facing roadmap commitments. - SDLC Improvement: Experience improving SDLC practices through AI-assisted engineering, automation, CI/CD, testing strategy, developer tooling, or platform engineering. - Global Delivery: Experience leading engineering teams across North America, Latin America, Europe, and India. - Transformation Environment: Experience operating in a private equity-backed, high-growth, or transformation-oriented software company. Success in 12 Months - Outcome Alignment: Engineering teams are aligned to clear customer, business, and operational outcomes across the Gym, Studio, and Enterprise portfolio. - Portfolio Ownership: The Ignite, Glofox, API platform, and staff-facing operational experience teams have clear priorities, strong ownership, and improving delivery predictability. - AI-Enabled Adoption: AI-enabled SDLC practices are adopted within the Gym, Studio, and Enterprise engineering organization in practical, measurable ways that improve productivity, quality, testing, documentation, release confidence, and operational support. - Global Team Effectiveness: Global teams across North America, Brazil, Europe, and India operate with strong alignment, clear communication, and consistent execution rhythms. - Customer Impact: Customer-impacting issues are reduced through improved quality practices, better observability, stronger ownership, and systemic fixes. - Platform Health: Platform reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability improve over time. - Cross-Functional Trust: Product, Customer Success, Support, Security, Infrastructure, and business partners view Engineering as transparent, outcome-oriented, and accountable. - Leadership Depth: Engineering leaders are growing, teams are engaged, and the organization has stronger leadership depth and succession coverage. - Technical Health: Technical debt and modernization priorities are clearly understood, sequenced, and actively addressed. - Enterprise Confidence: Enterprise customers experience improved confidence in ABC Fitness platforms, integrations, responsiveness, and operational stability. What We Value - Outcomes over outputs: We focus on measurable customer, business, and operational outcomes, not just shipped features or completed projects. Success means improving the experience for gyms, studios, enterprise operators, and the staff who rely on our platforms every day. - Systems over heroics: We build durable teams, platforms, and operating rhythms that scale globally. We value reliability, repeatability, and thoughtful execution over last-minute saves or dependence on a few key individuals. - Clarity over complexity: We make priorities, ownership, architecture, and tradeoffs clear. If a system, plan, or decision is too complex to explain, it is probably too complex to operate effectively. - Transformation with discipline: We embrace AI-enabled SDLC adoption and new ways of working, but we do so responsibly, measurably, and with clear support for teams through the transition. - Global alignment over local optimization: We lead as one engineering organization across North America, Brazil, Europe, and India. We value communication, shared context, and operating practices that help distributed teams stay aligned and effective. - Trust with accountability: We create psychological safety through transparency, blameless learning, and respectful challenge while maintaining high standards for ownership, quality, and follow-through. - High standards without ego: We believe strong leadership raises the bar while strengthening trust. We value direct communication, respectful challenge, humility, and accountability, creating an environment where teams can do their best work together. Compensation for this role will be determined based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, qualifications, skills, geographic location, and market considerations. The anticipated compensation range for this position is - United States candidates = $207,000 - $232, 500 USD- annually. In addition to base compensation, eligible employees may be offered other forms of compensation, such as bonuses, commissions, equity, or other incentive programs, where applicable. Compensation and benefits may vary by location and are subject to applicable legal, business, and market requirements.WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU: - Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset - Time Off – with our open PTO policy, we offer flexibility in how and when you take PTO! - Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam - Parental & Pawternity Leave – we offer leave for when your family grows by two feet or four paws! - Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement - Medical/Dental/Vision coverage - EAP – we get you help when you need it. Period. - Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16 - And more! – so many benefits we couldn’t even fit them all here! At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION:  ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. The Staff Platform Engineer leads the effort to locate, make visible, and remediate sources of unreliability in the MANTL platform, including correctness problems that surface under failure conditions. This role works directly in the platform's application codebase (TypeScript) and its container-native deployment environment, combining application-engineering skill with reliability-engineering practice at a level of scope and independence beyond the Sr Platform Engineer. In addition to resolving reactive issues as they surface, this role owns and prioritizes a standing roadmap of known reliability risks, driving that work forward on its own timeline.
